page.title: Change calendar
page.subtitle: Planned changes to Vireek's own pricing, terms, SLA and policies: who owns each, who approved it, when customers must be told and when it takes effect. Platform staff only.
page.emptyBody: Add a change to track its owner, approval, notice date and effective date.
page.noMatch: Nothing to show with this filter.
page.disclaimer: This calendar is a reminder system. It does not send customer notices and does not decide how much notice is legally required. [COUNSEL]

reminder.completion_due: Effective date passed: confirm and complete

locked: The notice was sent, so the content is locked. To change course, cancel this entry and create a new one.
shortfall_one: Recorded notice was {{count}} day short of the minimum you set. Informational only.
shortfall_other: Recorded notice was {{count}} days short of the minimum you set. Informational only.

form.title: Title
form.minNoticeHelp: Leave empty unless counsel has told you a number. [COUNSEL]
form.noticeLinkHelp: Id of the matching price change notice, if one exists.
form.editResets: Saving a change to an approved or pending entry returns it to draft and clears the approval.

errors.effective_in_past: The effective date cannot be in the past.
errors.dates_order: The effective date cannot be before the notice date.
errors.min_notice_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 365.
errors.min_notice_not_met: Notice date and effective date are closer than the minimum notice.
errors.url_invalid: Use a link that starts with https://.

actions.noteRejectHelp: A rejection needs a reason (at least 3 characters).
actions.noteCancelHelp: A cancellation needs a reason (at least 3 characters).
actions.markNoticeHelp: Only record this after the notice has really been sent. This system does not send it.

toast.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.
toast.selfApproval: You cannot approve a change you requested yourself.
toast.locked: The notice was already sent: this entry can no longer be edited.
toast.notYetEffective: The effective date has not arrived yet.
toast.noticeFirst: Record when the notice was sent first.
toast.pastEffective: The effective date is in the past.
